comment: Gut Feeling was an amazing class there is rarely homework, usually get out of labs way early, and the tests are very straightforward. She also always says "no one should loose sleep over Bio 199".

A Gut Feeling was by far my favorite class this year. Very lecture-heavy, so be prepared to take notes the entire hour; however, the material is very interesting. Her lectures are super engaging, and you think critically on tests. Professor O'Donnell was incredible, kind, and had very clear expectations. Also, very inviting towards questions.

Very kind professor who wants students to succeed in her class. Tests are very application based and can be very challenging if you do not have conceptual understanding of the content, but there are 4 throughout the year so you can recover from a poor performance during one or even 2.

Prof O'Donnell is very kind and passionate about biology. She genuinely cares about her students and believes “no one should lose sleep over BIOL199.” If you have taken biology before you will be fine. If you haven't, you will be fine too. Just pay attention in class. There is almost never any homework and the class content/labs are interesting.
Very easy class, no studying needed to get an A. You gotta pay some attention in class though. Very nice lady and would take again.

loved her so much. she cares about everyone but also you care about her because she is one of the kindest people ever. she made me love biology and she makes sure everyone does well in her class. so much respect for her

Super great professor. Never had any homework or studied for any of her tests because they were open note. Basically just pay attention and you will do great. Also really great for advice and outside help.

The topics covered in the class were presented in a very approachable way and the professor was very caring. She was not the most accessible outside of class, but the in-class assignments and lab were easy. The lab usually ended early and there was never any homework. If you want an easy and fun bio class take this one.

Professor O'Donnell is great! She is super passionate about biology and truly wants her students to enjoy learning about the human body. She makes it easy to do well as long as you show up and pay attention in class. Tests are specific, but as long as you take notes during class and make sure to ask questions you will do well. Overall great class!

She was truly a great professor! Really tries to make her students understand the topic. Labs are short and sweet, and entertaining. Test answers should be specific, so make sure you write EVERYTHING down during lecture.
Definitley not the easiest science gen ed

Prof O'Donnell has been my favorite professor so far. She was understanding, willing to meet, and always tried to make learning fun for us. We could correct tests, never had homework, and most of our points came from lab which was an automatic A for showing up. The only thing that set students apart grade wise was the tests, so make sure you study.

Professor O'Donnell is the best Professor ever! She is so kind, energetic, and intelligent. She keeps the information interesting and is willing to help you if necessary outside of class. She is amazing and cares for her students. I would 100% recommend taking her class.
This is the best class I took this semester. I loved prof o'donnell. She really cares about her students and the class is pretty easy! I highly recommend this class!
She is awesome! Pay attention and take part in class lectures. You will do very well if you complete everything, if you start to slack in labs she will take points off!!
